questions.question: Which type of plant has a soft, green stem and usually lives for only one or two seasons?

options.explanation: Trees have woody stems and live for many years.
Shrubs have woody stems and live for several years.
Herbs have soft, green stems and typically live for one or two seasons.
Climbers are plants that grow upwards by attaching to other structures.

questions.explanation: Herbs are characterized by their soft, green stems and short lifespan, unlike trees or shrubs which have woody stems.
questions.hint: This type of plant has a non-woody stem and is usually small in size.

questions.question: An animal that eats only plants is called a/an:

options.explanation: Carnivores eat only meat.

Herbivores eat only plants.
Scavengers feed on dead animals.

questions.explanation: Herbivores are animals whose diet consists exclusively of plant material.

questions.question: A bear eats berries, fish, and honey. Based on its diet, a bear is classified as a/an:

questions.question: Why should we avoid throwing garbage into rivers and lakes?

options.text: It makes the water look bad.
options.explanation: While true, this is not the most important reason.

options.text: It can harm aquatic animals and make the water dirty for human use.
options.explanation: Garbage pollutes water, harming aquatic life and making water unsafe for humans.

options.text: It is difficult to collect the garbage later.
options.explanation: While true, this is not the most significant reason.

options.text: Only A and C are correct.
options.explanation: Option B is the most correct answer.

questions.explanation: Throwing garbage into water bodies pollutes them, which is harmful to the animals living in the water and makes the water unsafe and unusable for humans. This option covers the most significant environmental and health impacts.
questions.hint: Garbage in water harms living organisms and makes water unsafe for use.
